purpose: Review a finite Campaign114 catalog against the complete v80 mechanism and source-semantic frontier before defining a factor or reading any Campaign114 official archive row, attachment, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: official_exchange_information_disclosure_evaluation_grade
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: An annual issuer-level information-disclosure work evaluation grade published by each issuer's listing exchange, used only after point-in-time publication timing and a common finite grade vocabulary are proven.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A holistic exchange evaluation of disclosure work is an external regulatory assessment distinct from audit-opinion binaries, issuer correction counts, inquiry/enforcement events, accounting fields, and minute price-volume paths. Selection proves only semantic independence; it does not prove that both exchanges expose a stable 2019-2025 archive or that their grade vocabularies can be frozen without seeing issuer rows.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: annual_report_text_readability_or_sentiment
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Text-derived readability or sentiment from annual reports.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Document extraction, tokenization, dictionaries, model versions, section boundaries, language normalization, and OCR would create a broad adaptive text-mining search family rather than one finite source state. It is not admissible without a separate complete text-method freeze.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: board_independence_ratio_from_current_company_snapshot
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Independent-director share calculated from a current company snapshot.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A current company snapshot is not a 2019-2025 point-in-time governance history and would introduce look-ahead and survivorship risk.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: additional_financial_statement_field_sweep
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Search unused balance-sheet, income-statement, or cash-flow fields and their ratios.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accounting-field family has already been repeatedly exposed; choosing another field or transform after observing prior outcomes is a statement-field rescue sweep rather than a new identified source state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: shareholder_meeting_or_general_announcement_intensity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Count shareholder-meeting or general issuer announcements in a rolling window.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This is another issuer-authored disclosure-count mechanism overlapping the frozen announcement-frequency, correction-burden, contract, guarantee, incentive and inquiry families.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_nonlinear_interaction_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Fit a tree, neural network, or other nonlinear model over the 134 frozen numeric components.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102 and Campaign103 already consumed or closed complete-library fitting and aggregation routes. Changing the model family after those results is an exposed model retry, not an independent factor mechanism.

next_stage: Freeze a finite official SSE/SZSE metadata-discovery protocol. Only after both exchanges prove a stable 2019-2025 issuer-code, evaluation-year, publication-date, grade and document-identity archive may a later campaign stage freeze an exact grade mapping, point-in-time timing, pure adapter and source contract before opening any attachment or issuer row.
